title: The Arctic Region
text: The Arctic is the northernmost region of Earth, centered on the North Pole. It consists of the Arctic Ocean and parts of Alaska, Canada, Finland, Greenland, Iceland, Norway, Russia, and Sweden. Unlike Antarctica, there is no land under the North Pole — it is a permanently (or seasonally) ice-covered ocean. The Arctic is warming at approximately twice the global average rate due to climate change, a phenomenon known as Arctic amplification. Indigenous peoples such as the Inuit, Yupik, and Nenets have inhabited Arctic regions for thousands of years. The region is rich in natural resources, including oil, natural gas, and minerals, leading to increasing geopolitical attention.
